observation_summary: The test fails with a NotSerializableException when attempting to serialize a mock object that has been configured with extra interfaces, indicating that the generated mock class does not correctly implement the Serializable interface in this specific scenario.
reasoning_summary: The failure occurs because the generated mock class (the CGLIB enhancer) is not serializable, despite the user requesting it via the API. This is a structural capability gap where the mock object generation logic fails to correctly incorporate the Serializable interface when extra interfaces are also present, requiring a design-level adjustment to how mock classes are constructed and initialized.
evidence_gaps: The internal implementation of the mock generation logic is not provided, only the test and the failure symptom.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: The issue is not a local procedural error but a failure of the mock object to satisfy the Serializable contract, which is a structural property of the generated class.
While it involves an interface (Serializable), the root cause is the failure of the object itself to implement that interface, not a mismatch in communication between two components.
